system.description: Among the most beautiful of the ceremonial golems ever created, the Feathered Serpent is 30 feet long and covered with rainbow colored plumage. The shell is crafted of articulated segments of orichalcum and ceramics and is covered with the feathers of many different types of enchanted birds, including a number of avian behemoths. In the First Age, the Feathered Serpent's creator and her entourage rode on a series of ornate saddles on the back of the feathered serpent, and it is rumored that Ride Charms would affect the mount as well. When not being ridden, the feathered serpent was also capable of "dancing" in a way described variously as alluring, beautiful and hypnotic. When functioning normally, the Feathered Serpent has control of the color of its feathers (with the bright rainbow colors being the default). This ability gives it a certain chameleon-like quality that lets it blend in with its surroundings (adding two dice to Stealth checks). When the golem is inert, the feathers turn a dull gray. Attributes: Strength 4, Dexterity 6, Stamina 4; Charisma 1, Manipulation 1, Appearance 6; Perception 5, Intelligence 1, Wits 1 Virtues: Automaton: Never fails Valor checks, never makes others Abilities: Athletics 5, Awareness 2, Dodge 4, Integrity 2, Linguistics 2, Martial Arts 1, Presence 3 (Hypnotic), Resis- tance 4, Stealth 3 Join Battle: 3 Attacks: Bite: Speed 4, Accuracy 9, Damage 5L, Defense 10, Rate 3 Tail Slap: Speed 5, Accuracy 6, Damage 4B, Defense 6, Rate 2 Clinch: Speed 6, Accuracy 7, Damage 10B, Defense ­, Rate 1 Soak: 12L/14B (Orichalcum plating, 10L/10B, Hardness: 7L/3B) Health Levels: -0/-1/-1/-1/-1/-2/-2/-2/-2/-2/-4/Incap Dodge DV: 5 Willpower: 10 (0 against its owner) Essence: 1 Other Notes: The Feathered Serpent's clinch attack actually involves squeezing its opponent in its coils, although it can do this to only those opponents that are the size of a large man or larger. Smaller targets can squirm out from between its coils.
